_about: Preflop strategy for full-ring (7-9 player) cash games against loose, passive players. These are hand-built approximations of common full-ring ranges with exploitative adjustments, NOT solver output. Edit freely; notation: 77+ (pairs 77 and up), ATs+ (ATs..AKs), TT-66, A5s-A2s, KQo, KQ (both suited and offsuit).

heads_up._about: Heads-up (2 players dealt). The small blind is the button: it acts first preflop and last after the flop, so it plays far more hands. Approximations of common heads-up strategy, not solver output.
